title: DreamScript IR node
description: One drawn shape. A node is anything a reader would point at and call a thing rather than a connection between things.

id.description: Unique within its diagram. Stable across re-runs of a converter so diffs are readable.

shape.description: What was drawn. Tightened to a closed vocabulary in schemas/shape.schema.json (Phase 2.1.4).

bbox.description: [x, y, w, h] in pixels of the image named by meta.image, origin top-left. Null when the source records structure but no geometry - see meta.geometry.

text.description: Transcribed content, empty string when the shape carries none. Never null: absent text and unread text are different states, and the second one belongs in low_conf_text.

semantic_role.description: What the shape means in its diagram type. Tightened to a closed vocabulary in schemas/role.schema.json (Phase 2.1.5).

confidence.description: Producer's belief in this node. 1.0 only for ground truth copied from a dataset annotation; anything inferred is scored below it.

source_id.description: Identifier this node had in the originating dataset, kept so a conversion can be audited against its source.

attrs.description: Type-specific extras that do not deserve a first-class field (a circuit component value, an HTML tag).
